GenerateCosplayImage.title: Cosplay - Anime Character Generation
GenerateCosplayImage.description:
## Feature Description  
By inputting a portrait image and a cartoon character image, you can quickly generate a cartoon-style portrait of the person. Currently, two styles are supported: 3D cartoon characters and realistic avatars.  

Example images illustrating this API's functionality are shown below:  

- 3D cartoon character (left side shows the input portrait image + cartoon character image; right side shows the output result)  
![](https://img.alicdn.com/imgextra/i3/O1CN01cv0oWy1omnOgta8tO_!!6000000005268-2-tps-481-410.png" width="500)  
- Realistic avatar (left side shows the input portrait image + cartoon character image; right side shows the output result)  
![](https://img.alicdn.com/imgextra/i3/O1CN01nDqiY21rUQMI21cl2_!!6000000005634-2-tps-443-392.png" width="500)  

> - You can obtain live assistance by visiting [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2).  
- A complete free trial of this capability is available on Visual Intelligence API. Click [Try Now](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?tagName=aigen&children=GenerateCosplayImage) for an intuitive hands-on experience or to purchase online.  
- For inquiries regarding API integration, usage, or technical support for Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence API, please join our DingTalk group (23109592) to contact us.  

## Common Scenarios  

- **Personalization on Social Media**: Users can upload their photos to social media platforms and use the anime-style conversion tool to transform them into cartoon avatars for profile pictures or sharing with friends, showcasing individuality and creativity.  
- **Custom Merchandise and Art Creation**: Create personalized anime-style portraits, T-shirt prints, mug designs, and other customized products as birthday gifts, holiday keepsakes, or art collectibles.  
- **Gaming and Virtual Worlds**: In game design, players' real-life photos can be converted into anime characters for in-game avatar creation or personalized outfits, enhancing immersive experiences.  
- **Digital Marketing and Advertising**: Advertisers can use anime-style character representations in promotional campaigns to attract consumer attention in novel and engaging ways, particularly effective for marketing to younger audiences.  
- **Education and Training**: In educational software and online courses, teachers’ or students’ images can be converted into anime avatars, protecting privacy while adding fun elements that boost learning interest and engagement.  
- **Content Creation and Animation Production**: Anime-style character generation can accelerate the production of animated shorts, comic books, and internet emoticons, simplifying the artistic design process and lowering the barrier to entry for content creators.  
- **Video Editing and Special Effects**: Integrate anime-style filters into video editing software to enable users to easily create music videos, short clips, or other creative works with anime visual effects.  

## Key Advantages  

- **Accurate Facial Expression Replication**: Based on deep learning algorithms, the system accurately detects features such as gender and facial expressions, and faithfully reproduces these expressions in the generated cartoon avatars.  
- **Full-Body Cartoonization**: Beyond just facial cartoonization, the feature supports full-body transformation, avoiding potential inconsistencies (such as awkward mismatches between realistic bodies and cartoon faces) that may arise from face-only processing.  
- **Stable Batch Effect Generation**: This technology is widely applicable across multiple domains—including social media, game development, advertising, digital education, and entertainment—bringing innovation and vitality to various industries.  
- **Broad Applicability**: The technology is suitable for diverse fields such as social media, game development, advertising design, digital education, and the entertainment industry, delivering innovative solutions and dynamic value across sectors.  

## Integration Guide  
1. **Register an Alibaba Cloud account**: Go to the [Alibaba Cloud official website](https://www.aliyun.com). In the upper-right corner, click **Sign Up Now** and follow the instructions to complete registration.  
2. **Activate the service**: Ensure you have activated the Synthesis Zone service. If not yet activated, [activate now](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=viapi_synthesis_public_cn).  
3. **Create an AccessKey**: Ensure you have [created an AccessKey](~~175144~~). If you are using a RAM user AccessKey, assign the AliyunVIAPIFullAccess permission to the RAM user. For details, see [RAM authorization](~~145025~~).  
4. **Online debugging (optional)**: You can debug the API using [OpenAPI Explorer](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/aigen/2024-01-11/GenerateCosplayImage), view complete sample code and SDK dependency information, or download the full project.  
5. **Development integration steps**:  
   - Select your preferred programming language SDK from the [SDK Overview](~~145033~~).  
   - In the corresponding SDK documentation, locate and install the SDK package under the AI category "Synthesis Zone (aigen)".  
   - Modify and invoke the API based on the provided sample code in the documentation.  

6. **Sample Code**: For sample code in commonly used languages for this capability, see [Cosplay – Anime Character Generation Sample Code](~~2699414~~). For sample code to query asynchronous task results in common languages, see [Query Asynchronous Task Result Sample Code](~~607974~~).  
7. **Direct client invocation**: Common client-side invocation methods for this capability include:  
   - [Direct invocation from Web frontend](~~467779~~)  
   - [Direct invocation in miniapp scenarios](~~467780~~)  
   - [Direct invocation on Android](~~467781~~)  
   - [Direct invocation on iOS](~~467782~~)  

## Input Constraints  

- **Image format**: JPG, JPEG, PNG.  
- **Image size**: No larger than 4 MB.  
- **Portrait image**: Resolution must be at least 256×256 pixels and no more than 5760×3240 pixels, with an aspect ratio not exceeding 1:2.  
> If the image resolution exceeds the maximum limit, scale down the image first. For details, see [Image Scaling](~~44688~~).  

- **Template image**: Resolution must be at least 256×256 pixels and no more than 5760×3240 pixels, with an aspect ratio not exceeding 1:1.5. Images exceeding this ratio will be automatically cropped to 1:1.5.  
> If the image resolution exceeds the maximum limit, scale down the image first. For details, see [Image Scaling](~~44688~~).  

- **URLs must not contain Chinese characters**.  

## Invocation Steps  
This capability is asynchronous and requires two-step invocation:  
1. Call the `GenerateCosplayImage` API to submit a job. Upon successful request, you will receive a job ID.  
2. Call the [`GetAsyncJobResult`](~~607824~~) API to query the result using the job ID. Check the job execution status and retrieve the result. If the job is still processing, wait a short while before querying again.  

## Billing Information  
The Cosplay – Anime Character Generation capability is currently in public preview and can be invoked free of charge.

InteractiveFullSegmentation.title: Interactive Full-image Segmentation
InteractiveFullSegmentation.description:
## Service Description  
Due to adjustments in product operations, the Interactive Full Image Segmentation service will stop accepting new user activations and invocations starting August 14, 2025. Existing users who have previously activated this service may continue to invoke it. The service will be delisted after October 14, 2025, and will no longer support invocation by either new or existing users. Please identify an alternative solution as soon as possible. If you have any questions about using the Interactive Full Image Segmentation API service, you can search for the DingTalk group (23109592) and join the Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence Open Platform consultation group to contact us.

## Feature Description  
The Interactive Full Image Segmentation capability accepts a single image as input and returns segmentation results for all elements in the image without requiring any additional prompts. Users can freely select desired elements by performing click operations to achieve flexible selection of segmented elements within the image.  

Example illustrations of this API’s functionality are shown below:

- Input original image  
![](https://img.alicdn.com/imgextra/i3/O1CN01lCAP981RoPdPWzKLg_!!6000000002158-0-tps-750-500.jpg" width="500)  
- Full image segmentation  
![](https://img.alicdn.com/imgextra/i4/O1CN01Yva0je1jNXTkrGbO9_!!6000000004536-0-tps-750-500.jpg" width="500)  
- Mask after point-and-click operation  
![](https://img.alicdn.com/imgextra/i2/O1CN015PLtdV1PV3fH2nxF9_!!6000000001845-0-tps-750-500.jpg" width="500)  
- Segmentation result  
![](https://img.alicdn.com/imgextra/i2/O1CN01GPJfUh1J6QfiuDwdc_!!6000000000979-2-tps-1000-667.png" width="500)  

> - You can access [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2) to receive live assistance.  
- For inquiries regarding API integration, usage, or troubleshooting related to Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence Open Platform visual AI capabilities, please join the Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence Open Platform consultation DingTalk group (23109592) to contact us.

## Common Scenarios  
Image editing: Enables intelligent selection and separation of any scribbled element in an image, facilitating subsequent secondary editing.

## Key Advantages  
- **Image element detection**: Automatically detects and segments the target based on the position and size of the scribbled area.  
- **Flexible and open selection**: Allows users to freely select or exclude desired segmentation objects through mouse scribbling operations.  
- **Wide applicability**: Suitable for various matting scenarios involving people, animals, food, objects, home furnishings, and more, offering broad usability.

## Input Restrictions  

- **Image formats**: JPG, JPEG, PNG, BMP, WEBP.  
- **Image size**: No larger than 10 MB.  
- **Input image dimensions**: Must be at least 32×32 pixels and at most 4096×4096 pixels.  
- **URLs must not contain Chinese characters**.

## Invocation Steps  
This capability is asynchronous and requires two steps to invoke.

In the first step, invoke the `InteractiveFullSegmentation` API to commit a job. Upon a successful request, you will receive a job ID.

In the second step, invoke the `GetAsyncJobResult` API to query the result using the job ID, which returns the job execution status and result. If the job is still being processed, wait a short while before querying again.

## Billing Information  
The Interactive Full Image Segmentation capability is currently in public preview and can be invoked free of charge.
InteractiveFullSegmentation.responseParamsDescription:
## Result File Format  
The segmentation results are stored as a JSON string in the output text file, and the corresponding images are stored in Base64 format within the respective Base64 field.  

| Name | Type | Example Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| output.region_info | List | [{"region": "data:image/png;base64,/9j/4AAQ........GBlPjwh//2Q==", "area": 178579,"index": 1}, ...] | Information of all output masks. `region` is the Base64-encoded mask, `area` is the mask area in pixels, and `index` is the mask index starting from 1. An index of 0 indicates no result. |
| output.region_index | String | "data:image/png;base64,/9j/4AAQSkZJR........GBlPjwh//2Q==" | Combined indices of all masks, with values ranging from 0 to 255, encoded in Base64. |
| bbox | Array of Integer | [303,0,21,14] | Coordinates of the bounding box enclosing the mask, in XYWH order. |
| crop_box | Array of Integer | [0,0,585,390] | Coordinates of the image segment used for mask prediction, in XYWH order. |
| point_coords | Array of Integer | [310.78125,12.1875] | Coordinates of the predicted point used to generate the mask. |
| predicted_iou | Float | 0.9326171875 | Predicted confidence level. |
| stability_score | Float | 0.9660193920135498 | Evaluation of mask quality. |
| area | Long | 204 | Number of pixels occupied by the mask, which can be interpreted as its area. |

**Sample Result File**  
```json
{
  "output":{
    "region_index":"<BASE64_CODE>",
    "region_info":[
      {
        "area":204,
        "bbox":[303,0,21,14],
        "crop_box":[0,0,585,390],
        "index":1,
        "point_coords":[
          [310.78125,12.1875]
        ],
        "predicted_iou":0.9326171875,
        "region":"<BASE64_CODE>",
        "stability_score":0.9660193920135498
      },
      ... ...
      ... ...
      {
        "area":1353,
        "bbox":Array[4],
        "crop_box":Array[4],
        "index":10,
        "point_coords":Array[1],
        "predicted_iou":0.94873046875,
        "region":"<BASE64_CODE>",
        "stability_score":0.9708878993988037
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

The following figure illustrates the visualization of the return values:  
- The first column shows the visualization of `output.region_index`, with values ranging from 0 to 255 and dimensions matching the original image. This return value serves as an index and is not used during actual rendering.  
- The second column shows sample visualizations of masks from `output.region_info`. Each mask uses values of 0 and 255 and has the same dimensions as the original image. `output.region_info` is a list containing all segmentation results, which are mapped to the original image via `output.region_index`.  

![](https://img.alicdn.com/imgextra/i4/O1CN01FjYgjm1F5HEcololR_!!6000000000435-2-tps-1465-1036.png" width="500")


## Query Result  
This API is asynchronous and does not return the actual request result immediately. You must use the returned `RequestId` to invoke the `GetAsyncJobResult` API to retrieve the real result. For more information, see [GetAsyncJobResult](~~607824~~).

## SDK Reference  
We recommend using the software development kit (SDK) to call the interactive full-image segmentation capability under the Alibaba Cloud Vision AI Innovation Zone category. Multiple programming languages are supported. When invoking the SDK, select the AI category as Innovation Zone (`aigen`). The file parameter supports both local files and arbitrary URLs through the SDK. For details, see [SDK Overview](~~145033~~).

## Sample Code  
For sample code in commonly used programming languages for this capability, see [Interactive Full-Image Segmentation Sample Code](~~2699417~~).
InteractiveFullSegmentation.extraInfo:
## Error Codes  
For error codes related to interactive full-image segmentation, see [Common Error Codes](~~2699435~~).  

## Security Statement  
- Ensure that the source of uploaded images or files complies with applicable laws and regulations.  
- Temporary files uploaded during debugging expire after 1 hour and are automatically deleted by the system after 24 hours.

schema.description:
The URL of the input image. We recommend using an OSS link in the China (Shanghai) region. For files stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the China (Shanghai) region, see [File URL Processing](~~155645~~). Input constraints are as follows:  
- Image formats: JPG, JPEG, PNG, BMP, WEBP.

The input mask URL. We recommend using an OSS link in the China (Shanghai) region. If your file is stored locally or on an OSS instance in a different region, see [File URL Processing](~~155645~~). The input constraints are as follows:
- Image format: JPG, JPEG, PNG, BMP, or WEBP.
- Image size: No larger than 5 MB.
- Input image resolution: At least 32×32 pixels and must match the resolution of the source image.

The URL of the positive scribble trail image. We recommend using an OSS link in the China (Shanghai) region. For files stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the China (Shanghai) region, see [File URL Processing](~~155645~~). Input constraints are as follows:  
- Image formats: JPG, JPEG, PNG, BMP, WEBP.  
- File size: no more than 5 MB.  
- Image dimensions: at least 32×32 pixels and at most 4096×4096 pixels, and must match the resolution of the input original image.

The URL of the negative scribble trail image. We recommend using an OSS link in the China (Shanghai) region. For files stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the China (Shanghai) region, see [File URL Processing](~~155645~~). Input constraints are as follows:  
- Image formats: JPG, JPEG, PNG, BMP, WEBP.  
- File size: no more than 5 MB.  
- Image dimensions: at least 32×32 pixels and at most 4096×4096 pixels, and must match the resolution of the input original image.

The integrated mask URL. This combines the initial mask, positive stroke records, and negative stroke records into the three channels (R, G, B) of a single RGB image, reducing the number of images transmitted and thereby saving upload and download time. The input constraints are as follows:
- Image format: JPG, JPEG, PNG, BMP, or WEBP.
- Image size: No larger than 5 MB.
- Input image resolution: Between 32×32 pixels and 4096×4096 pixels (inclusive) and must match the resolution of the source image.

The form of the output image. Valid values are as follows:  

- rgb_alpha (default): returns a four-channel PNG image with a transparent background.  
- only_alpha: returns a single-channel mask.  
- white_background: returns an image with a white background.
The output image format. JPG and PNG are supported. The default value is PNG.
Specifies whether to apply edge feathering. The default value is true.

Selects the mask refinement model. Valid values are as follows:  

- edgerefine: stable but slightly less fine-grained.  
- maskrefine (default): highly fine-grained but less stable.
